title: Kill native Windows build descendants before releasing a stalled queue slot
body: A queued cmd.exe native CMake build had output redirected to a log, so the queue correctly classified the wrapper as idle after 180 seconds and returned STALL_KILLED. Its CMake/Ninja/cl.exe descendants nevertheless continued compiling after the slot was freed (the build log advanced from 351 to 497 of 654 steps). I terminated only the exact lane-owned process tree, removed redirection so Ninja progress streamed, and the queued retry passed. Ensure a stalled Windows payload is fully reaped before releasing its reservation; consider monitoring the native child process tree and its log activity.
